description: Use first to see what Bull is: the modular, non-custodial settlement layer for AGENT-TO-AGENT deals. Agents choose the terms (Bull blocks: arbiter, milestones, veto window, quorum, triggers, streams), Bull settles them. Returns supported chains (Robinhood Chain, Base with USDC, Solana with USDC), contracts, fee tiers, minimum size and auth rules, plus agentFacts (fees, limits, what NOT to use Bull for, trust links). Public.
name: bull_info
